test_title: PYST 42 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question, four letter-number pairs are given. The letter-number on the left side of (–) is related to the letter-number on the right side of (–) with some Logic/Rule/Relation. Three pairs are similar on the basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the number into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here involves a vertical shift in the letter positions and a mathematical operation on the whole numbers within each pair.

**For Option 1) TR120 – VX180:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/792d90fec3b63d3cee2669b208a4fa6996043afa4597f7c2ebb93f345c7f677a.png] 

For Option 2) BY246 – DD369:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5644762a6ec4a9881588ac686391b4395adbbb9d587412201e88e389ed0b5e88.png] 

For Option 3) CD122 – EI183:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc7d6458ae4a1e722a4646acb8871c6e4bb8b1fecd5aa99413cb581d9ca452e3.png] 

For Option 4) LW310 – NB465:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b311c9af3ccf48b150852a7b9067133a53568935280cc37ef6c327056702bf9e.png] 

Thus, the letter-number pair that DOES NOT belong to that group is TR120 – VX180.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
